visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, shoulder-length hair and a green-and-white striped shirt sits on a grey sofa in a minimalist living room. He holds a red rectangular product box depicting fried chicken. On the wooden table in front of him, several other colorful product boxes are neatly arranged in two rows. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the red 'Taiwanese Fried Chicken' facial mask box. The box features illustrations of fried food, a yellow peace-sign hand logo, and Traditional Chinese text. The man's hands are visible holding the box steadily against the bright indoor background. (3) The man is shown tearing open a white foil pouch. He pulls out a folded, dripping wet white sheet mask. His facial expression is one of exaggerated excitement, with a wide open-mouthed smile and raised eyebrows. He holds the mask up toward the camera. (4) The man applies the white facial mask to his face, carefully smoothing it over his forehead and cheeks with both hands. He wears a black beaded bracelet on his left wrist. The background remains the neutral-toned living room with a sofa and white wall. (5) Wearing the facial mask, the man holds up different boxes to the camera. One is yellow with a picture of mango shaved ice. He gestures with his hands, touching the mask on his chin to show fit. Yellow captions appear at the bottom of the frame. (6) The scene cuts to the man holding three boxes at once: pink, green, and orange. These show milk, juice, and rice dishes. He continues to speak energetically, his eyes wide and expressive behind the cutouts of the white mask. (7) A close-up shows a clear glass on the table. A hand pours beige powder from a slim sachet into the glass. Then, clear water is poured in, and a transparent straw stirs the mixture, turning it into a milky brown liquid. (8) Back to a medium shot, the man picks up the glass and takes a sip through the straw. He looks directly at the camera with an impressed expression, gesturing towards his throat and the glass. (9) The man holds a pile of colorful product boxes in both arms, laughing heartily. The camera is slightly handheld, creating a dynamic feel. More yellow and white variety-style captions overlay the bottom and middle of the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High arousal male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a very fast rate with a bright, energetic tone. The background music is a high-tempo pop track with a prominent electronic beat and synthesized melodies. (2) A sharp digital 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition. The speaker's volume increases as he emphasizes a point, his pitch rising into a playful, excited register. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. (3) A burst of loud, high-pitched laughter from the male speaker. Following the laughter, the narration continues with a rhythmic, almost melodic delivery style. There is a faint ambient room tone underneath the primary tracks. (4) A distinct sound of crinkling plastic occurs as a package is opened. The speaker's voice becomes slightly muffled for a moment, then returns to full clarity as he continues his energetic monologue. (5) A short, low-frequency 'thud' sound as a box is placed on the table. The BGM beat-matches the speaker's cadence. The vocal intensity remains high with frequent pitch inflections. (6) A splashing sound of liquid being poured into a container. This is followed immediately by a sharp 'pop' sound effect used for a graphic transition. The speaker continues talking without pause. (7) A metallic clinking and scraping sound of a straw stirring inside a glass. The speaker makes a 'slurping' sound, followed by a vocalized 'ah' of satisfaction. The BGM begins to swell slightly in the mix. (8) Another series of 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects accompany rapid visual transitions. The speaker's voice maintains a professional yet comedic narrative tone, with high articulation clarity. (9) The speaker concludes with a final loud laugh and a cheerful closing phrase. The music maintains its energy until the very end, where a quick fade-out occurs.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Demonstration -> Comparative Listing -> Final Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a unique and somewhat bizarre line of Taiwanese food-flavored facial masks and collagen powders available at Watsons. The creator uses humor and high energy to describe the unexpected scents (like fried chicken) and tastes of the products, turning a beauty review into an entertaining variety-style segment.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: On-screen Watsons logo, verbal callout to the store, and a detailed showcase of NutriPlus (活沛多) brand products.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a classic Taiwanese variety show editing style with high-density captions, meme-like sound effects, and an extremely expressive host to drive engagement for a potentially polarizing novelty product.
